FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Prestige Realty Group specializes in providing full-service real estate solutions, focusing primarily on residential property sales and transactions. Our operations include representing clients in buying, selling, and leasing properties while ensuring compliance with local real estate laws and regulations. We maintain a robust risk management strategy and have a team of experienced, licensed agents dedicated to exceptional client service. We foster relationships with reputable vendors, including title companies and mortgage lenders, to streamline transactions and enhance client satisfaction. Our commitment to transparency is reflected in our detailed documentation practices for all transactions, minimizing the risk of misrepresentation. We consistently train our staff on regulatory compliance, ensuring our practices align with fair housing and anti-discrimination policies. As we focus exclusively on acting as intermediaries in property transactions, we do not engage in activities that could introduce additional complexities, which helps us mitigate potential liabilities.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In January 2023, we experienced a liability claim due to a miscommunication regarding property listings, resulting in legal costs of $3,000. The matter has been resolved, with no ongoing litigation. Additionally, a minor incident in July 2022 involved property damage during a showing, costing $2,000 for repairs, which is also resolved. Total losses amount to $5,000.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the property perimeter, along with on-site watchpersons during business hours to enhance safety and mitigate unauthorized access.
